name: goggles-worn
description: Robot Goggles worn look (issue #45): the head layer draws the goggles through their own 3D item/goggles_worn model in the HEAD display context, every other view keeps the flat icon. 1.21.10+ switches models in items/goggles.json; 1.21.1 gets the same switch from the build's item-model downport (neoforge:separate_transforms), so the node to compare is 1.21.1 against the rest. Four husks (sun-proof, so they stand still at noon) show the goggles from the front, a three-quarter turn, the side and the back (strap and chipset), then the player wears them in both third-person views, in the inventory doll and as a held item.

steps.label: window 1600x900 so one skin pixel of a head 2 blocks away is ~20 screen pixels
stand in the rig's chunks first (a fresh world has them unloaded)
clear leftovers, floor, noon, bare head and hand
run: item replace entity @p armor.head with minecraft:air
item replace entity @p weapon.mainhand with minecraft:air

steps.label: husks facing the camera, turned 45, side on, and back to the camera
run: item replace entity @e[type=minecraft:husk,tag=bcgog] armor.head with buildcraftunofficial:goggles

steps.name: stands
steps.look: four husks, each wearing the 3D goggles round its head (iron frame, glass, black strap), NOT a flat icon stuck to the face. The camera faces south, so right to left: front, three-quarter, side, back

steps.name: front
steps.look: close-up, face on: two lenses over the eye row, rounded frame corners, a plain bridge between them, strap running off both sides

steps.name: three-quarter
steps.look: close-up, turned 45: the frame stands only slightly proud of the face, the strap wraps the side of the head

steps.name: side
steps.look: close-up, side on: a thin profile, the strap a flat band round the head, no part floating off it

steps.name: back
steps.look: close-up, from behind: the redstone chipset sits on the back of the strap

steps.label: husks away (into the void, so no death puff or drops in the next shots), goggles on the player
run: item replace entity @p armor.head with buildcraftunofficial:goggles

steps.name: third-back
steps.look: third person from behind: strap round the back of the player's head with the chipset on it, sitting on the hair, not sunk into it

steps.name: third-front
steps.look: third person facing the player: goggles over the eyes, same as the front husk

steps.label: survival, so the inventory key opens the doll and not the creative tabs

steps.name: inventory
steps.look: the doll wears the 3D goggles; the head armour slot shows the flat goggles icon, lit flat (not shaded like a block)

steps.name: held
steps.look: the flat goggles icon in the right hand and in the selected hotbar slot, never the 3D head model

steps.label: clean up
run: item replace entity @p armor.head with minecraft:air
item replace entity @p weapon.mainhand with minecraft:air
